facts.fact: Algeria's Ministry of Interior presentation says a digital identity was launched at large scale in 2025 and integrated into the national digital services portal.
Algeria's Ministry of Interior says that since 2018 the NIN is generated automatically from the civil register (RNAEC) when a birth is registered.

DZA.note: No count or share of people holding the NIN is stated.

facts.fact: Algeria's Ministry of Interior says each newborn receives its own birth certificate and unique national identifier (NIN) once registered, since 2018.
The presentation says the NIN is generated automatically from the national automated civil register (RNAEC) for each newborn after registration, since 2018.

DZA.note: The document does not say who operates, maintains or owns the platform.

facts.fact: Algeria's Ministry of Interior says that in 2023 the NIN was adopted by all government authorities and partner sectors including justice, banking, social security, taxation and education.
Algeria's Ministry of Interior says the NIN was set up in 2010 and is associated with each individual's biometric data, guaranteeing its unique character.
The presentation says the NIN is tied to each person's biometric data to guarantee definitive uniqueness.
